newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran quake kills 2,000 - state radio.
newsitem.headline: Iran quake kills 2,000 - state radio.

text.p: Up to 2,000 people have been killed in a powerful earthquake that hit eastern Iran on Saturday, state-run Tehran Radio said early on Sunday.

The radio, monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation, quoted an Iranian Red Crescent statement as saying the casualty toll had risen to 2,000 in the earthquake, which measured 7.1 on the Richter scale. The radio had earlier said 1,000 were killed.
